currentCoordinate.coordNote: The main point identifies the central interpreted ironworks and water-power core; a second anchor extends the record along Andelva without reusing Eidsvollsbygningen or the broad village point.

previousCoordinate.reasonReplaced: The legacy point lay approximately 5.71 kilometres northeast of the documented works, Krutthuset and central Andelva interpretation environment.

identity.resolvedIdentity: The central historic ironworks and water-power landscape at Andelva, including the surviving Krutthuset, vanished production buildings and the interpreted river corridor, distinct from Eidsvollsbygningen and the modern village.
identity.identityProblem: The name combines a vanished industrial complex with a river corridor. A village point is too broad, Eidsvollsbygningen is a separate building record and no single surviving structure represents the entire landscape.
identity.splitReason: A central industrial interpretation anchor plus a secondary Andelva anchor can represent the coherent core without duplicating the building record or claiming the whole river.

requiredEvidence: official documentation of the ironworks and Andelva energy relationship
explicit separation from Eidsvollsbygningen and the village point
radius justification covering both anchors without claiming the full river or legal geometry

evidence.finding: Eidsvoll Jernverk was established at Andelva in 1624. Water power supported refining and later sawmill, rolling-mill and mill functions, while Eidsvollsbygningen was the owner's residence inside the wider industrial complex.
evidence.reason: Resolves the historical and functional landscape but does not expose a reusable map point.

evidence.finding: Krutthuset is the only surviving building from the old Eidsvold Jernværk and is probably a seventeenth-century timber powder house.
evidence.reason: Confirms a surviving industrial element near the selected core but does not alone represent the entire landscape.

evidence.finding: The works once included more than thirty utility and residential buildings, with smithies, hammer buildings, charcoal stores, sheds and a blast furnace. Surviving traces include Krutthuset, slag heaps, Eidsvollsbygningen and a pavilion.
evidence.reason: Confirms that one surviving building or the political house cannot by itself represent the industrial landscape.

evidence.finding: The named interpretation point lies at 60.30153, 11.1709 in the immediate former works and water-power core, approximately 82.4 metres from Eidsvollsbygningen and close to Krutthuset.
evidence.reason: Provides a stable, place-specific semantic anchor for the industrial and hydrological subject rather than the adjacent political building.

evidence.finding: The point lies at 60.30129, 11.17689, approximately 331.1 metres east of the main anchor, and represents the interpreted Andelva corridor.
evidence.reason: Applied as a secondary route and river-industry anchor rather than the canonical display marker.

evidence.finding: The village point lies at 60.30204, 11.16768, approximately 186.2 metres from the applied anchor.
evidence.reason: Confirms locality identity but is too broad to represent the historical works and river-industry landscape.

evidence.finding: The building anchor at 60.30079, 11.17098 lies approximately 82.4 metres from the industrial anchor and has its own political canonical record.
evidence.reason: Explicitly excluded to prevent duplication of the Eidsvollsbygningen place.

evidence.finding: The legacy coordinate 60.3297, 11.2575 lies approximately 5,705.5 metres northeast of the applied industrial interpretation point.
evidence.reason: Replaced because it does not represent the former works, Krutthuset or central Andelva corridor.

sourceObjectCandidates.rejectionReason: Broad village point rather than the industrial landscape.

rawEvidence.description: Persisted official industrial identity, surviving-element context, anchor candidates, calculated distances and radius decision.

decision.nextAction: Applied the central water-power interpretation point, added the Andelva secondary anchor, expanded the radius to 360 metres and continue with Tertitten / Urskog-Hølandsbanen.

notes: The coordinate moves approximately 5.71 kilometres from a remote incorrect point.
The industrial anchor is distinct from the Eidsvollsbygningen building only 82.4 metres away.
The secondary Andelva anchor lies 331.1 metres east and is included by the 360-metre gameplay radius.
The radius is not a legal heritage, property, historical works or full river-corridor polygon.
The village point is retained only as a locality cross-check.
